text: ここは　ひとが　とまる　りょかん　ですじゃ　あいにく　へや　いっぱい　でな

structure.jp: ひとが　とまる　りょかん　ですじゃ
structure.en: is an inn where people stay

structure.jp: へや　いっぱい　でな
structure.en: the rooms are full, you see

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ひとが　とまる　りょかん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, tells you which thing. ひとが　とまる　りょかん = 'an inn where people stay'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-person way of saying だ, 'is'; here it is tacked onto です for an elderly feel. りょかん　ですじゃ = 'it is an inn'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で is だ in its 'and so' form, leaving the rest unsaid, and な softens it like 'you see'. いっぱい　でな = 'they're full, you see, so...'
